summary: Frontend-only verification of Egypt listing page (/afrika/aegypten) and single detail page (/afrika/aegypten/egypt-explorer-grand). All 40+ assertions passed: listing hero/title/cta/image, expert section (image loads), features, 2 activity cards, 6 place cards, 3 faq items, tour category tabs with correct counts (Culture=3, City breaks=3, Nile cruises=9, Round trip & beach=3, total=18), all card images load, Grand Luxury card navigates to detail slug, other cards return to listing. Detail page: title, meta (11 days / 6 stops / Flights, cruise & coach / From $1,690 p.p.), 3 gallery images load, breadcrumb Egypt->/afrika/aegypten, included panel toggles (9 included, 4 excluded), route tabs A-F, route-tab-C shows 'Kom Ombo & Edfu', 4 stats, 8 glance-items, TourList excludes featured (RTB shows 2 instead of 3). Unknown slug redirects to listing. Homepage Africa tab -> Egypt card links to /afrika/aegypten and navigates. Responsive 390px: no horizontal overflow on either page, no console errors on any page.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: featured object uses duplicate key 'stops' (scalar '5 stops' overwritten by array of 6 stops). The scalar isn't read at runtime (code uses t.stops.length for stops count) so it's harmless, but the '5 stops' literal in egyptData.featured is dead. Confirms hero shows '6 stops' correctly.
Non-critical: TourList used on both listing and detail pages resets to first category ('Culture') on each render — expected behavior but worth documenting.
Non-critical: Expert image on listing lacks a data-testid; naturalWidth verified via DOM query.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Egypt listing + single detail page behaviors verified via Playwright at 1920 and 390 viewports. No console errors. featured.stops (scalar) is a dead duplicate key in egyptData.js — safe but could be cleaned.
